What I like is that they've finally changed to listing capacity ranges
by giving the first value of the block. I've always thought that made
more sense than their previous practice of avoiding the "equals" case
by going to the first value over the line. Finally, I won't have to
mentally convert things like "capacity above three" into "capacity of
four or greater" (well, except for old printings and old cards... but
it has to start somewhere and I'm very glad they're making that
change).
